architecture.mechanism: An automated system combining machine learning with interpretability to enable robust decision-making and control across diverse operational contexts.
architecture.intervention: Integrate an automated, ML-based engine immobilizer controller with interpretability features into the Kia starting system, such that the system monitors key authentication signals and makes real-time decisions to permit or block engine activation based on authorized credentials.
architecture.expected_effect: The starting system would reliably prevent unauthorized engine activation when the key is removed, complying with FMVSS requirements for starting systems that prevent engine activation and forward mobility.
architecture.falsification_test: Test whether the ML-based immobilizer system blocks engine cranking when an unauthorized or absent key is detected, and permits cranking only when a valid authenticated key signal is present, verifying compliance with FMVSS starting system requirements.
